# LinkedIn Profile Finder by Name & Company

> Find a LinkedIn profile from first name, last name, and company by running the Mawsool LinkedIn Profile Finder on Apify.

This repository is an example client. Run the published Mawsool Actor on Apify with your own Apify token. Contact info@mawsool.tech · osama@mawsool.tech. Product site: https://mawsool.tech.

## Actors

- [LinkedIn Profile Finder by Name & Company](https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-profile-finder): the Actor this code runs
- [All Mawsool Actors](https://apify.com/oday): the full LinkedIn data suite

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/odayali1/find-linkedin-profile-by-name/blob/main/README.md): how to run the example and what it returns
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/odayali1/find-linkedin-profile-by-name/blob/main/AGENTS.md): instructions for coding agents
- [Example CSV](https://github.com/odayali1/find-linkedin-profile-by-name/blob/main/examples/input.csv): input shape
